assets.label: Tablier de cuir
assets.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: complete production character sprite for Project RL, a grimdark futuristic/cyberpunk roguelike with native 64px cells. Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, the existing outfit: retain identity, material colors, clothing/armor layout, proportions, stance and full face covering. Input image 2 is ONLY the accepted finish reference Bastion, never a character to copy. Give the target the same matte worn game painting, broad readable shadow planes, believable folds and material volumes, controlled irregular dark contours, restrained highlights and locally placed wear. No shiny plastic, sterile vector/cel shading, thick uniform outlines, noisy microdetail or giant shoulder armor. Readable at about 60 game pixels tall. Same slightly elevated frontal standing view as the target and reference, no isometric view. Neutral diffuse overhead light. Whole figure from head to soles, complete limbs, generous margins, TRUE TRANSPARENT background. No scene, ground, cast shadow, words, frame, glow or effects. Feet slightly apart; empty gloved fists slightly out to the sides at waist level, bent elbows, ready for separate weapon attachments. No weapon or new accessory. Leather apron outfit: matte dark blue sleeves and shoulders, a dirty cream/ivory long leather work apron reaching the upper thighs, dark trousers with blue knee panels, black gloves and dark boots. Dark head covering with a short ochre brown strip above an opaque black face covering. Preserve the apron, its length and the blue/ivory/brown color placement.
